description: Is this export in the npm package's published type declarations — Checks that up to 20 named exports (functions, classes, constants, types, default) exist in the .d.ts files published for an exact npm package version, read from jsDelivr, for coding agents that may be calling an API that does not exist. Follows export lists and relative export-star re-exports within the package (at most 7 files) and reports when the export surface cannot be fully enumerated. Neve

typesPath.description: Declaration file path inside the package, overriding package.json resolution.

version.description: Exact version or dist-tag (jsDelivr resolves it).

name: symbol-exists
